description: This file contains functions for parsing date strings in various formats (ISO 8601, RFC 2822, ASP.NET JSON) and converting them into Date objects, including regex patterns and configuration functions.

methods.name: configFromISO
methods.description: Parses ISO 8601 date strings using regex patterns and sets the configuration accordingly.

methods.name: configFromRFC2822
methods.description: Parses RFC 2822 date strings, handling time zones and day-of-week validation.

methods.name: configFromString
methods.description: Attempts to parse date strings in various formats, including ISO, RFC 2822, and ASP.NET JSON, with fallback handling.
